title: Show HN: Sigabrt.dev – cronjob monitor with an SSH TUI
summary: A lightweight cronjob and uptime monitoring service for self-hosted projects. Users ping an endpoint from their scripts, and if pings stop, they receive notifications via email or ntfy. The service includes an experimental SSH TUI for read-only monitoring access.
problem_solved: Provides simple heartbeat monitoring for self-hosted services and cronjobs to detect failures and downtime.
why_valuable: Offers a minimal, zero-setup alternative to complex monitoring systems with unique SSH TUI access for tech-savvy users who prefer command-line interfaces.
